column1: # The ladder-census triage freeze - the recorded dispositions for census rows
# whose candidate files are NOT in the current mismatch band on both routes
# (LadderBindingCensusTest.enforceBandGate). Every row carries its reason; the
# freeze is BIDIRECTIONAL (an unused row fails). Class-grain rows disposition a
# whole (cell, RowClass) by one recorded argument; the per-cell count pin in
# expected-summary.tsv keeps class rows honest - a NEW differing binding moves
# the pinned counts and fails the census before the class row could hide it.
# The drr 7.x SAME_DENOTATION rows were NOT here at #568 - the class was then
# fully in-band. Seats 1-13 (#571-#583) took the OFF band from 1,507 to 587
# (cell,file) rows, so part of every class moved OUT of band; measured at the
# stage-exit head f63cff66, drr 7.x reads AUTH_ONLY 474 in / 862 out,
# SAME_DENOTATION 63 in / 126 out, REBIND 27 in / 13 out per cell - which is why
# each of those classes now carries a row below. The in-band slices need no
# triage: the flip's fix classes are authorized by their band membership. Every
# split above moves as the flip heals more files; the count pin is what fails
# first if the census itself gains a differing binding.
# AT SEAT 33 (#605, head bf0519655) THE BAND REACHED ZERO ON BOTH ROUTES (matrix
# d47fa88f = 0 / 174,129 / 12; band-off.tsv and band-on.tsv re-extracted to ZERO rows).
# Every row of every class is therefore OUT-OF-BAND and dispositioned by its class row;
# the in-band slices are EMPTY, the freeze's staleness direction holds (every class
# row is USED), and the expected-summary.tsv count pin is the operative guard.
# AND IT IS NOW THE ONLY GATE THAT FIRES ON NEW REACH. With this file's four
# new drr 7.x rows, EVERY (cell, RowClass) group that carries rows has a CLASS:
# row, so enforceBandGate's VIOLATION direction is inert in all 25 cells - an
# out-of-band candidate is class-exempt everywhere. Its STALENESS direction still
# bites (a row that stops being used fails). The operative guards are therefore
# expected-summary.tsv's per-cell pin - which the stage exit widened from four
# counts to six facts, adding the candidate-file count AND a digest of the sorted
# set, because a count cannot see a row re-pointing at a different file - and the
# 25x2 matrix's identical-never-drops, compared digest-to-digest at every seat.
